battle.name: 唐攻龜茲之戰
battle.brief: 貞觀二十二年（648年），唐以龜茲與西突厥內應、收留焉耆王為由，遣阿史那社爾率漢軍與西突厥部眾討之。兵分五道，多褐城一戰破龜茲五萬眾，六百里追王至撥換城，圍攻四旬乃克，都城及七百餘城皆降。卡面的羅馬弩砲為公元前50年前後的羅馬扭力投射器，與本役相隔近七百年，並不在現場。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐帝國在貞觀二十二年（648年）對塔里木盆地北緣的龜茲國發動的一次征服性遠征，交戰雙方的形態都與一般王朝戰爭不同。唐方是以行軍大總管制為骨幹的混合部隊：漢軍主體是抽調自北衙禁軍與折衝府的步騎兵，骨幹由伊州、沙州等西域都督府屬下的兵將充任，作戰序列上以阿史那社爾所領的西突厥內附部眾（處月、處密、處彌山諸部以及鼠尼孜等粟特部騎兵）為先導與迂迴力量，另有西突厥相屈利啜主動請求率本部隨征；唐廷在中樞另置安西都護一職，由郭孝恪鎮守新得的都城，權祗甫、崔義超等則隨軍辦理糧秣與招撫。龜茲一方是以都城為核心、四周數十城邑結成的城邦聯盟，國王訶利布失畢（漢籍作布失畢，姓白）居都城，丞相那利總攬兵權，大將羯獵顛領兵，盟內城邑各有守將，遇警即棄城而走。其背後還站着西突厥阿史那賀魯的部眾，龜茲一度收容與唐交好的焉耆王薛婆阿那支，把唐的屬國變成自己的附庸。戰局牽動的第三方是整個西域：于闐、安國等國在唐軍攻克之後競相奉送駝馬與軍糧，西突厥則從最初的敵對轉為內附，焉耆在唐軍扶立新王之後重新向唐修貢。這說明此役在唐的西域體系中是一次方向性極強的行動：要處理的並非單一敵國，而是城邦聯盟與遊牧霸權交錯的整片交通地帶。
countriesEn: This war was a conquest expedition launched by the Tang empire in the twenty-second year of Zhenguan (648) against the kingdom of Kucha on the northern rim of the Tarim basin, and on both sides the shape of the war differed from an ordinary dynastic conflict. The Tang side was a mixed force built on the framework of the travelling army great commander: the Han Chinese core was infantry and cavalry drawn from the Northern Gate guards and the zhe-cheng fu, with the backbone supplied by officers and men from the western protectorates such as Yizhou and Shazhou, and in the order of battle the lead and the turning force were the surrendered Western Turkic peoples under Ashina She'er, that is the tribes of Chuyue, Chumi and Chumishan together with Sogdian riders such as the Runnizi, while the Western Turkic chancellor Qulizhuo asked of his own accord to lead his own contingent in the campaign. At the centre the court created the post of Protector of the Western Regions, and Guo Xiaoke was left to hold the newly taken capital, while Quan Zhipu and Cui Yichao accompanied the army to handle supplies and pacification. The Kucha side was a league of city-states bound together around a capital: the king Qiaolibushibi, called Bushibi in the Chinese histories and of the Bai clan, resided in the capital, the chancellor Nali held the military authority, the general Jieliedian commanded the troops, and every member city had its own commander, most of whom abandoned their walls at the first alarm. Behind them stood the followers of the Western Turk Ashina Helu, and Kucha at one point sheltered the Yanqi king Xuepo'ana who had fled to Tang, converting a Tang dependency into its own vassal. The third parties drawn in were the western regions as a whole: Khotan and Anguo competed to send camels, horses and military grain after the Tang victory, the Western Turks turned from adversaries into subjects, and Yanqi resumed its tribute to Tang under a ruler installed by the Tang army. All of this shows that the campaign was a strongly directional move within the Tang western system: what had to be dealt with was not a single enemy state but an entire zone of traffic in which city-state leagues and nomadic powers overlapped.
people: 決策者是唐太宗李世民。貞觀二十二年，龜茲與西突厥互相呼應，又收留反叛的焉耆王，使西域北道的局勢脫離朝廷掌控；太宗沒有再像對高昌那樣只遣一支偏師敷衍，而是讓已內附的西突厥將領阿史那社爾出線，授以行軍大總管，節制漢軍、蕃軍與西域諸國的援應。阿史那社爾是處彌山可汗之孫，久已仕唐，熟悉天山南北的道路與城邑；此役他分兵五道，自焉耆之西趨龜茲北境，出其不意，先斬焉耆王薛婆阿那支而立其從父弟先那准為焉耆王，隨後屯兵磧口，以伊州刺史韓威率千餘騎為前鋒、驍衛將軍曹繼叔次之，在多褐城以偽退誘敵三十里合擊，一戰而大破龜茲五萬之眾。追擊與攻取由他一手推動：長驅六百里追布失畢至撥換城，圍攻四旬而拔之，擒布失畢與羯獵顛；事後遣左衛郎將權祗甫宣諭各城，終得七百餘城相率請降，並勒石紀功。西域出身的阿史那賀魯自請為鄉導，以昆丘道行軍總管的身分隨軍，也說明唐廷早已把手伸進西突厥內部。龜茲方面的關鍵人物是國王布失畢、丞相那利與大將羯獵顛：那利在主力覆滅之後仍兩度率兵反攻都城，一度靠城內降胡接應攻破外城、殺死鎮守的安西都護郭孝恪，兵鋒直逼城內軍資；城中由倉部郎中崔義超臨時募集二百人守衛軍資才沒有失控，最後兵敗被龜茲人擒獲送至軍門。布失畢於次年正月被押解京師，太宗責讓而釋之，以左武衛中郎將安置，至貞觀二十四年八月才詔復其王位、遣還國中。
peopleEn: The decision was Emperor Taizong's, Li Shimin. In the twenty-second year of Zhenguan, Kucha and the Western Turks were answering each other, and Kucha was sheltering a rebelling Yanqi king, so that the situation on the northern road of the western regions slipped out of the court's control; Taizong did not repeat the half-measure he had used against Gaochang but let the already submitted Western Turkic commander Ashina She'er take the field, granting him the post of travelling army great commander with authority over Han troops, tribal troops and the support of the western states. Ashina She'er was a grandson of the Chumishan kaghan and had long served the Tang, and he knew the roads and the towns north and south of the Tian Shan. In this campaign he divided his force into five columns, approached the northern border of Kucha from the west of Yanqi, took the enemy completely by surprise, cut down the Yanqi king Xuepo'ana and set his cousin Xiannazhun on the Yanqi throne, then moved his camp to Qikou. He sent the governor of Yizhou Han Wei with more than a thousand horsemen as the vanguard and the Brigadier General Cao Jishu in support, and at the city of Duohè he feigned a retreat, drew the Kucha army thirty li out of the city, joined forces with Cao Jishu and destroyed the fifty thousand men assembled there. The pursuit and the reduction were carried through by his own hand: he pursued Bushibi for six hundred li to the city of Bohuan, stormed it after forty days, and took both Bushibi and Jieliedian prisoner; afterwards he sent the Left Imperial Guard colonel Quan Zhipu to explain the situation in the other towns, and in the end more than seven hundred cities came over of their own accord, and he carved a stele to record his merit. Ashina Helu, a native of the western regions, asked to serve as guide and marched with the army as travelling army great commander of the Qikiu route, which shows how far the Tang court had already reached inside the Western Turkic confederation. The key men on the Kucha side were the king Bushibi, the chancellor Nali and the general Jieliedian. After the destruction of the main army, Nali still twice led troops back against the capital, and on one occasion, with the help of Kucha turncoats inside the walls, broke into the city, killed the Protector of the Western Regions Guo Xiaoke who was holding it, and drove straight at the military stores within; only because Cui Yichao, a director of the bureau of stores, hastily raised two hundred men to guard the treasury did the situation not collapse, and Nali was finally beaten and handed over by Kucha men at the camp gate. Bushibi was escorted to the capital in the first month of the following year, the emperor reproved him and then released him, settling him as a left guard middle general, and only in the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year of Zhenguan was an edict issued restoring him to his throne and sending him home.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲是公元前五十年前後羅馬人用的扭力投射器：以皮條搓成的繩束蓄能，張弦靠人力絞車，一發射出一具手臂長的重箭，射程可達數百步，主要用來壓制城頭、拆毀城牆與城門，羅馬人正是靠這類器械和騎兵配合，拆掉了希臘的城牆與城邦體系。與本場戰役相隔近七百年，它不可能出現在龜茲的城下，648年真正在城頭交會的是唐軍的弩與攻城器械。通鑑記此役攻城只用「拔其城」「攻之四旬」數語，器械細節從略，但按唐代常規用兵，唐軍先以步弩、車弩（連弩之車，《墨子·備高弗》記其「二十弓之弩，一車三張」）與飛石覆蓋城頭、壓制守軍，再以撞車撞門、雲梯登陴，最後配合騎兵迂迴，與羅馬弩砲同屬以機械蓄能、以單發重投射物破壞城防的思路，只是在蓄能方式上分道揚鑣：羅馬靠扭力束，唐弩靠弩機絞弦。龜茲方面則以夯土版築的城牆、高聳的佛寺塔樓充作觀敵與射擊的高地，士卒用西域常用的角弓、標槊、長刀與皮甲作戰，糧秣靠城內囤積與天山雪水灌溉的渠道調節。唐軍的裝備重心則放在騎兵與後勤：鞍具齊備的機動部隊分擔追擊與包抄，駱駝隊馱運軍糧、器械與柴水，長途沙漠作戰的成敗大半由這條補給線決定。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card is a torsion engine of the kind the Romans used around the fiftieth year before our era: energy is stored in a bundle of skinned sinews twisted by a windlass, the bow is drawn by manpower, and each shot looses a single bolt as long as an arm, with a range of several hundred paces, its purpose being to sweep the parapets and to break walls and gates. It was with machines of this kind, combined with cavalry, that the Romans pulled down the walls of the Greek cities and with them the Greek system of city-states. Standing nearly seven hundred years away from the campaign under discussion, it could not have stood beneath the walls of Kucha; what actually met on the parapets in 648 was the Tang crossbow and its siege gear. The Tongjian records the reduction of the city in a bare phrase, that the city was taken, and that it was besieged for forty days, without details of the engines, but by the ordinary practice of Tang warfare the army first covered the parapets and pinned the defenders with foot crossbows, cart crossbows, the repeating crossbow carriage whose twenty bows and three reloads per cart are described in the Mohist chapter on the defence of Besie Gao, and stone-throwing engines, then rammed the gates with battering rams and climbed the walls with scaling ladders, and finally closed with cavalry turning the position. This is the same logic as the Roman scorpio, storing energy in a machine and breaking a defence with a single heavy projectile, but the two parted ways in how the energy was stored: Rome used a torsion bundle, the Tang crossbow used a windlass and trigger mechanism worked by the ratchet. On the Kucha side the defences were walls of rammed earth laid up in courses, with the tall towers of the Buddhist temples serving as platforms for observation and archery, while the troops fought with the horn bows, long spears, sabres and leather armour of the western regions, and fed themselves on grain stored inside the walls and on the channels fed by snowmelt from the Tian Shan. The Tang on the other side put the weight of its equipment on cavalry and logistics: mobile troops with complete harness took on the pursuit and the envelopment, and camel trains carried military grain, engines, firewood and water, so that the outcome of a long march across the desert was decided more by that supply line than by the fighting.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術主軸是騎兵迂迴加上縱深攻城，而不是硬撞城牆。阿史那社爾把大軍分成五道，自焉耆以西直趨龜茲北境，用分散與突然令守將棄城而走，再屯兵磧口，距都城尚有三百里即先取焉耆王首級以震全境；接著在多褐城以韓威部千餘騎偽裝敗退，誘龜茲五萬眾離城追出三十里，與曹繼叔部合而擊之，一戰追出八十里，龜茲主力自此崩潰。布失畢輕騎西走之後，唐軍沒有立刻壓上都城，而是派沙州刺史蘇海政、尚輦奉御薛萬備率精騎長追六百里，把國王堵在撥換城，以四旬之久的圍城攻下，迫使王與大將一同被擒，隨後才回師接管都城。攻拔都城後的變數來自內部：那利引西突厥眾及龜茲兵萬餘人夜襲城外的安西都護郭孝恪，因城中有降胡接應而一度攻入城中，殺死郭孝恪，兵鋒直逼城內軍資；這時崔義超臨時募得二百人守住資貨，曹繼叔、韓威兩部又從城外西北隅反擊，才把叛軍逐出，斬首三千餘級。旬餘之後那利再引山北龜茲萬餘人反攻都城，又被擊破，斬首八千級，那利單騎遁走終被龜茲人擒送軍門。最後一段不是攻而是勸降：權祗甫奉命分赴各城，開示禍福，七百餘城相率請降，唐軍因此不逐城攻取而能全線接收。補給方面，戰區內的駝馬軍糧由西域諸國饋送，唐軍自身以駱駝馱運，越過瀚海的遠程戰術因此得以維持。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this campaign was cavalry turning movement combined with a deep assault on the city, not a head-on battering of the walls. Ashina She'er divided his army into five columns and drove straight from the west of Yanqi to the northern borders of Kucha, using dispersal and suddenness to send the defenders abandoning their cities, and then camped at Qikou; when he was still three hundred li from the capital he had already taken the head of the Yanqi king to shake the whole region. At the city of Duohè he had Han Wei's more than a thousand horsemen pretend to be beaten, drew the fifty thousand Kucha men out of the city and thirty li in pursuit, joined with Cao Jishu's column and struck, pursuing them for eighty li, and the Kucha main force collapsed from that moment. After Bushibi rode west with a light horse, the Tang did not immediately press on to the capital; instead they sent the governor of Shazhou Su Haizheng and the official for the sacred carriage Xue Wanbei with elite horse to pursue him six hundred li, shut the king up in the city of Bohuan, and took the city after a siege of forty days, forcing the king and the general to be taken together, only then returning to take over the capital. The variable after the capital fell came from within: Nali brought more than ten thousand men, Western Turks and Kucha soldiers alike, to fall on the Protector of the Western Regions Guo Xiaoke outside the walls at night, and because Kucha turncoats inside the city answered them, they broke into the town, killed Guo Xiaoke and drove at the military stores within. Only then did Cui Yichao hastily raise two hundred men to guard the stores, while Cao Jishu and Han Wei struck back from the north-west corner of the city outside and drove the attackers out, cutting off more than three thousand heads. Ten days or so later Nali brought more than ten thousand Kucha men from north of the mountains against the capital once more, was beaten again with eight thousand heads cut off, and fled on horseback alone until Kucha men caught him and brought him to the camp gate. The last phase was not assault but persuasion: Quan Zhipu was sent to the various towns to set out the consequences of resistance, and more than seven hundred cities came over of their own accord, so that the Tang could take the whole line over without storming city after city. On the supply side, camels and military grain came as gifts from the western states of the theatre, while the Tang carried its own on camels; the far-reaching tactics across the desert were sustained on that basis.
data: 可查證的數字集中在《資治通鑑》卷一百九十九的記載裡。多褐城一戰，龜茲王訶利布失畢、丞相那利與大將羯獵顛合兵五萬拒戰；唐軍前鋒是伊州刺史韓威所率千餘騎，偽退三十里後合兵擊潰，追擊八十里。追捕國王的行程為六百里，撥換城圍攻歷四旬，至貞觀二十二年閏月丁丑攻克。戰後斬首數：都城反擊戰三千餘級，山北那利再攻一戰八千級。社爾全期前後攻破大城五座，遣使招撫後得七百餘城相率請降，俘虜男女數萬口。距離上，社爾進屯磧口時距龜茲都城尚有三百里；行軍作戰分五道推進，焉耆王薛婆阿那支被擒斬，其從父弟先那准被立為焉耆王。時間線上，出兵在貞觀二十二年，翌年即貞觀二十三年正月辛亥，布失畢與那利等至京師，太宗責讓而釋之，以布失畢為左武衛中郎將；貞觀二十四年八月壬午，詔復以布失畢為龜茲王，遣歸國撫其眾。背景數字可參《大唐西域記》：玄奘於貞觀三年西行時經過龜茲，記其國城周二十餘里，寺廟三百餘所、僧眾三千餘人，通行小乘佛教。
dataEn: The figures that can be documented are concentrated in the Tongjian, volume 199. At the battle of Duohè the Kucha king Qiaolibushibi, the chancellor Nali and the general Jieliedian together led fifty thousand men to refuse the attack; the Tang vanguard was the more than a thousand horsemen of Han Wei, governor of Yizhou, who feigned a retreat for thirty li before joining forces and routing them, with the pursuit carried on for eighty li. The distance covered in the pursuit of the king was six hundred li; the siege of Bohuan lasted forty days, and the city was taken on the dingchou day of the intercalary month of the twenty-second year of Zhenguan. Heads cut off after the fighting: more than three thousand in the counter-stroke at the capital, and eight thousand in the second attack by Nali from the north of the mountains. Over the whole campaign Ashina She'er broke five great cities, and after sending emissaries out he obtained the surrender of more than seven hundred cities which came over of their own accord, taking captive several tens of thousands of men and women. As for distance, when She'er camped at Qikou he was still three hundred li from the Kucha capital; the advance was made in five columns, the Yanqi king Xuepo'ana was caught and beheaded, and his cousin Xiannazhun was set on the Yanqi throne. On the chronology, the army set out in the twenty-second year of Zhenguan; in the first month of the following year, the twenty-third, on the xinhai day, Bushibi, Nali and the others reached the capital, the emperor reproved them and released them, and Bushibi was made a left guard middle general; in the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, on the renwu day, an edict restored Bushibi to the throne of Kucha and sent him home to look after his people. For background figures one can turn to the Great Tang Record of the Western Regions: Xuanzang passed through Kucha on his westward journey in the third year of Zhenguan and recorded a capital whose circuit was more than twenty li, more than three hundred monasteries and more than three thousand monks, with the Hinayana in use.
cause: 開戰的直接理由是唐廷判定龜茲已與西突厥內應，切斷了安西的北道。貞觀中期，唐在塔里木盆地北緣先後取得高昌故地、伊州、焉耆等據點，於闐、龜茲一線則始終維持羈縻式的往來；龜茲地控天山南北的重要隘口，境內又是西來佛教與文物的集散地，商旅、僧侶與使節的通道都經過它的城下。貞觀二十二年前後，龜茲與西突厥的阿史那賀魯往來密切，又把投奔唐廷的焉耆王薛婆阿那支收容進境，等於把唐在西域的兩處屬國變成自己的附庸與人質；阿史那社爾等西突厥降將向朝廷陳報此事，指出若不討伐，龜茲就會成為西突厥重新控制塔里木的支點，朝廷在北道上的全部經營都會失去依託。太宗因此決斷出兵，這與他此前在西域的一貫做法一致：凡阻絕朝貢、倚強凌弱、與突厥相應者，必以兵討之，擒其王而釋之，郡縣其地，使西域諸國重新認識唐的兵威。地理上這是一次成本極高的遠征，從伊州、焉耆出發，橫穿數百里瀚海與戈壁，糧秣仰賴駱駝馱運與西域諸國接濟；太宗仍願意承擔這份成本，因為在通往中亞的商路上，龜茲一城的位置重於它本身的國力。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the war was the Tang court's judgement that Kucha had entered into a correspondence with the Western Turks and was cutting the northern road of Anxi. In the middle of the Zhenguan era the Tang had taken one by one the former territory of Gaochang, Yizhou and Yanqi on the northern rim of the Tarim basin, while the line of Khotan and Kucha was kept on looser, tributary terms; Kucha controlled an important pass north and south of the Tian Shan, and within its territory lay a gathering place for Buddhism and for goods coming from the west, so that the routes of merchants, monks and envoys all passed beneath its walls. Around the twenty-second year of Zhenguan Kucha was in close contact with the Western Turk Ashina Helu and was sheltering the Yanqi king Xuepo'ana, who had fled to the Tang court, which amounted to turning two Tang dependencies into Kucha's vassals and hostages. Western Turkic commanders such as Ashina She'er reported all this to the court and argued that if Kucha were not attacked it would become the pivot on which the Western Turks regained control of the Tarim basin, and that everything the court had built on the northern road would lose its support. Taizong therefore resolved to send troops, in line with his consistent practice in the western regions: those who blocked tribute, relied on strength to bully their neighbours and corresponded with the Turks were to be attacked by force, their kings taken and then released, their country turned into commanderies and counties, so that the states of the west would learn once more the weight of Tang arms. Geographically this was an expedition of very high cost, setting out from Yizhou and Yanqi and crossing several hundred li of desert and gravel, with the grain depending on camel transport and on the gifts of the western states; Taizong was still willing to bear that cost, because on the trade road leading to Central Asia the position of the city of Kucha mattered more than the native strength of the state.
impact: 此役的結果是龜茲的城邦體系被拆散，通道本身則變成唐朝的軍鎮。唐軍在龜茲城設西州，將其置於唐的州縣與都督府體系之下，與其後於658年設立、治交河城的安西都護府相銜接；龜茲從此是安西四鎮之一，也是北道商路上的唐軍屯戍點，絲路北線的交通從此有唐兵護持，使節與僧侶往來不再受制於本地城邦的態度。佛教交流也隨之加密：龜茲是西域小乘佛教的中心，寺廟與僧眾密集，唐僧往來此地的記錄不絕；二十世紀初德、法探險隊在龜茲一帶的庫木什拉、圖木舒拉克等地發現大批唐代漢文、梵文、藏文寫經與文書，1958至1959年中蘇聯合考古隊又在蘇巴什古城佛寺出土唐代佛經與文書，這些材料證實唐代龜茲與漢地、與中亞之間在宗教與商業上的往來相當密切。政治上，龜茲的臣服改變了西域的權力平衡：西突厥加速內附，于闐、安國等國主動靠攏，焉耆換了對唐更恭順的君主；同時唐的前線也從河西推到了天山南麓，治理成本與被反覆挑戰的風險一併增加，貞觀二十四年詔復布失畢王位，反映的正是新附地區內部的動盪；八世紀末吐蕃攻陷龜茲，更證明這一線的脆弱。
impactEn: The result of the campaign was that the city-state system of Kucha was taken apart, and the corridor itself became a garrison of the Tang. The Tang army set up the prefecture of Xizhou at the city of Kucha and brought it within the system of Tang prefectures and protectorates, linking it with the Protectorate of the Western Regions established in 658 with its seat at Jiaohe; from then on Kucha was one of the four garrisons of Anxi and a Tang outpost on the northern trade road, the traffic of the northern branch of the Silk Road was thereafter escorted by Tang soldiers, and the movement of envoys and monks no longer depended on the disposition of the local city-states. Contact in religion grew denser as well: Kucha was a centre of the Hinayana in the western regions, with dense monasteries and numbers of monks, and the record of Tang monks passing through is continuous; in the early twentieth century German and French expeditions found at Kumtura and Tumshuk in the Kucha area large quantities of Tang manuscripts and scriptures in Chinese, Sanskrit and Tibetan, and between 1958 and 1959 a joint Sino-Soviet archaeological team brought Tang scriptures and documents out of the monastery at the ancient city of Subashi, and this material confirms how close the religious and commercial intercourse of Tang-era Kucha was with the Chinese homeland and with Central Asia. Politically, the submission of Kucha rearranged the balance of power in the west: the Western Turks hastened to become subjects, Khotan and Anguo drew closer of their own accord, and Yanqi received a ruler more obedient to the Tang. At the same time the Tang front line was pushed from the Hexi corridor to the southern foot of the Tian Shan, bringing with it the cost of governing and the risk of being challenged again and again; the edict of the twenty-fourth year of Zhenguan restoring Bushibi to his throne reflects precisely the unrest inside the newly submitted region; and the Tibetan capture of Kucha at the end of the eighth century shows only too well how fragile that line was.
result: 就作戰本身而言，結果是完勝而代價有限：龜茲都城被拔，王弟葉護被立為國主，七百餘城相率歸降，俘男女數萬口，社爾勒石紀功而還；國王布失畢與丞相那利於貞觀二十三年正月被押至京師，太宗責讓數句即行釋放，以左武衛中郎將安置，次年又復其王位遣還國中善後。那利兩度夜襲都城、殺死安西都護郭孝恪，是全役最險的一段，若非崔義超臨時募兵守資、曹繼叔與韓威及時自西北隅反擊，朝廷在塔里木北緣的據點可能當夜易手。從更長的視角看，這場戰爭的真正成果不在龜茲城本身，而在於它完成了一套破城、設州、置兵的動作：先以騎兵迂迴分割、以砲弩與撞車破防、以圍城斷糧逼降，再用安西都護留戍與西州建制把佔領固定下來，於是塔里木北道從此歸入唐朝的防衛圈。卡面那件羅馬弩砲在這裡還有另一層意味：羅馬人用這類扭力投射器拆掉希臘城邦的城牆，唐軍在龜茲用的是弩車與撞車，兩者原理雖異，用意卻同，攻城器械與騎兵機動一旦結合，數百座城便能在一季之內易主，城邦聯盟的秩序隨之崩解。
resultEn: As to the fighting itself, the result was a complete victory at limited cost: the Kucha capital was taken, the king's brother Yabhu was set on the throne, more than seven hundred cities came over of their own accord, several tens of thousands of men and women were taken captive, and Ashina She'er carved a stele of his merit and returned. The king Bushibi and the chancellor Nali were brought to the capital in the first month of the twenty-third year of Zhenguan; the emperor reproved them in a few words and then released them, settling Bushibi as a left guard middle general, and in the following year restored him to his throne and sent him home to put matters in order. Nali's two night attacks on the capital and the killing of the Protector of the Western Regions Guo Xiaoke were the most dangerous moments of the whole campaign, and had Cui Yichao not hastily raised men to guard the stores and had Cao Jishu and Han Wei not struck back in time from the north-west corner, the Tang foothold on the northern edge of the Tarim could have changed hands in a single night. Seen over the longer run, the true product of this war was not the city of Kucha itself but the completion of a set of operations, breaking the city, establishing a prefecture and stationing troops: first cavalry turning movement to divide the enemy, then bolt-throwers and battering rams to breach the defences, then siege and denial of grain to force surrender, and finally a Protector left to garrison and the establishment of Xizhou to fix the occupation in place. The northern road of the Tarim thereby entered the defensive ring of the Tang. The Roman scorpio on the card carries a second layer of meaning here: the Romans pulled down the walls of the Greek city-states with machines of this kind, and the Tang used cart crossbows and battering rams at Kucha; the principle differed but the purpose was the same, and once siege engines and cavalry movement are combined, several hundred cities can change hands within a single season and the order of a city-state league collapses with them.
